text:
miguel: Heads-up — saw a perf regression on a 16-GPU job with flash-attn + TP when sequence windowing is enabled. Latency jumps ~18% at 2k tokens.
lauren: repro steps? which model/quant/TP layout?
miguel: 70B dense, TP=2, PP=1, nvf32->q4f16 quant profile. Regression shows up only when we enable small-window KV caching (prefix windowing) + continuous batching.
arya: interesting. did you check all-gather sizes? those can change with windowing and cause non-power-of-two chunking.
miguel: yes — profiler shows many extra allgathers with tiny payloads. perf-bot posted a snapshot:
perf-bot: profile summary (1823456815): p99 latency 240ms -> 283ms (+18%), allreduce overhead +12ms, small-allgather count +2100
oliver: can you paste the kernel timeline? small-allgather spikes usually correlate with mismatch between q,k slice alignment + shard padding.
miguel: timeline snippet:
```
[0.000s] compute: qkv linear (ok)
[0.003s] compute: flash_attn_fwd
[0.007s] comm: all_gather(qkv_shard, size=3.2kB)
[0.010s] comm: all_gather(qkv_shard, size=3.2kB)
[0.013s] compute: attn_softmax
[0.020s] comm: all_gather(kv_cache, size=2.8kB)
```
This repeats many times per step.
lauren: sizes in KB — tiny. That rings true: ring chunking overhead dominates when payload < ~16KB.
arya: could be our windowing heuristic chopping sequences mid-tensor so shard boundaries no longer align with TP slices. Then allgather can't coalesce.
miguel: I instrumented kvcache offsets. Found irregular mod strides when seq_len % window != 0 => scatter/pad per shard.
oliver: is this specific to flash-attn? or affects native attn too?
miguel: native attn shows smaller impact because it uses a different kernel ordering (we do per-device matmul then reduce). Fused flash-attn pipeline interleaves qkv gather which surfaces the tiny allgathers.
lauren: immediate mitigation: increase window coalescing threshold to avoid creating tiny shards. e.g. if resulting allgather < 8KB, fallback to full-shard gather.
arya: put differently: when (seq_stride * shard_count) < MIN_AGG_SIZE, force aligned padding to next multiple of chunk_size.
miguel: I prototyped a small change in batching heuristics — pad kvcache per-device by up to 128 tokens to avoid sub-16KB messages. Microbenchmarks:
```
before: step_time=0.283s
after pad 128: step_time=0.247s (~-12%)
```
lauren: nice. any downside? memory bloat from padding?
miguel: +0.6% VRAM for 70B across 16 GPUs, acceptable for now. But want a better permanent fix in kernel selection layer.
oliver: maybe kernel selector should prefer an execution path that delays allgather aggregation until we can coalesce across pending requests (work-stealing window). But that's heavy.
arya: another idea: make TP communication aggregator that batches tiny allgathers across micro-batches within the same host tick — basically intra-step coalescing.
miguel: tried intra-step coalescing in runtime; reduced messages by 40% but added 1ms queuing. Net -7% latency improvement (not as good as padding). Tradeoffs.
lauren: could be fine as a secondary optimization. First land heuristic padding to kill the regression, then follow up with smarter coalescing and a selector rule.
miguel: filing an RFC and a small PR for the heuristic: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4128 (WIP)
lauren: add test in perf-regression suite that simulates windowed KV with TP=2 and checks for small-allgather counts.
arya: one more: edge-case with flash-attn's qkv memory layout — when using qkv fused tensors we need to ensure our allgather call uses a contiguous view, otherwise NCCL does extra copies. Might be a contributor.
miguel: noted. I'll add a check to use contiguous() before ncclAllGather in the TP path if the tensor stride != 1.
oliver: ok also ping infra to restart the nightly 16-GPU perf job after the PR lands.
perf-bot: scheduled re-run: nightly-perf-16g (id: nf-1823456820)
lauren: thanks team — sounds like a clear next-step plan: land padding heuristic hotfix, add regression test, pursue coalescing and kernel-selector improvements.
miguel: I'll open the hotfix PR today and run the guarded canary on dedicated. Will post results here.
oliver: 👍
arya: :thumbsup:
miguel: small follow-up log when repro was flaky:
```
If seq_len == 1024 and window=96, shard_offset = 1024 % (window*tp) => 64 -> creates 3x allgather of ~4KB. Fix: pad to 128 -> allgather 16KB.
```
lauren: sweet. keep notes in the PR description.
miguel: will do.
